title: The Lantern Workshop: Four Signal Puzzles
visibleText:
The signal tower needs its lanterns tonight. Four crates just arrived. You are the Inspector. Check each crate, file your report, and the tower lights at the end.

Reports go to the tower keepers, and they write back later — so no crate will tell you if you were right. If a crate puzzles you, mark it Needs another look. That is a real inspector's answer.
